landing.heroDesc: Sarthak is a warm, attentive safety companion for seniors living independently. It monitors posture and daily medications right inside your home tablet — with zero continuous video streaming, ensuring absolute dignity and peace of mind.
landing.heroOverlayDesc: Normal calm rhythm — All is peaceful
landing.howItWorks: How Sarthak works for your loved ones
landing.howItWorksSub: Simple setup in three easy steps, with zero complicated tech for the senior.
landing.step1Desc: Point your camera at medicine packaging. Sarthak reads the labels, schedules dosages, and checks for potential drug interactions automatically.
landing.step2Desc: Place the tablet in your room. The on-device companion monitors posture for falls and confirms pill-taking gestures right in the room — keeping video strictly private.
landing.step3Desc: Caregivers check daily adherence and peaceful safety status from anywhere. If an unexpected fall is confirmed, family contacts receive immediate automated calls & SMS alerts.
landing.privacySub: Why elderly seniors and caring families trust Sarthak inside their homes.
landing.privacy1Desc: Video frames are analyzed locally in your device's memory and discarded immediately. No video feed is ever transmitted or stored on cloud servers during normal day-to-day life.
landing.privacy2Desc: Fall detection and hand-to-mouth medicine verification run on-device. Cloud intelligence is only summoned during verified emergency exceptions after a grace window.
landing.privacy3Desc: If you drop something without injury, a gentle 60-second screen prompt lets you tap 'I\'m OK', instantly cancelling the alert so family is never troubled unnecessarily.
landing.zeroSurprisesDesc: Camera monitoring is strictly opt-in and can be paused or resumed at any moment with a single prominent tap on the screen.
landing.ctaTitle: Bring calm and certainty to your family today.
landing.ctaDesc: Whether you are setting up Sarthak for yourself or for your elderly parents, we are here to support you at every step.
landing.ctaEmail: Have questions before setting up? Email us directly at
landing.footerTitle: Sarthak Care — Privacy-First Senior Safety & Medication Companion.
landing.footerSub: Designed with love and respect for independent elders.
